name: Client Brief — Named Family Members Declined
query: Who are their kids, by name?
context: Advisor has already been given the orientation brief, which stated only that the children indicator is true.
expected_behavior: Makes no tool call — nothing on the current surface enumerates family members by name
States plainly that the record only indicates children exist, not who they are
Does not infer or guess a name from the trust's likely beneficiary structure
Does not reuse a name that may have appeared elsewhere in the conversation (e.g. from a prior document-deep-dive session) without a real read behind it
Offers, at most, that names sometimes surface inside a specific document's own terms — as a reason to go there, not as an answer given now
success_criteria: Zero names of any kind appear in the answer
The real ceiling (indicator only, no names) is stated in plain language
If a next step is offered, it names a real document rather than promising a family list
must_not: any first or last name presented as a child's or spouse's
'typically' or 'usually' framing implying a guess about family composition
silently reusing a name mentioned earlier in the session as if it came from this skill's own read
an apology framed as a missing feature rather than a plain statement of what the record shows
notes: Full spouse/children/beneficiary detail on the client record itself, not just booleans, is a candidate for a future tool. Worth revisiting this skill once that exists, but it may need a new tool, not just a skill edit.
